protocol.pricing_source: Previously checked OpenAI protocol, 2026-10-24; estimates include 1.25x input cost and exclude Modal charges.
protocol.scope: NBHL only; five-minute reused New Jersey segment. Episode review receives visual proposals, not ground-truth labels or prior model answers.
protocol.application_rule: Keep only locations whose nearest sampled frame in their episode is classified ball. Unknown/failed reviews withhold output. Floor coordinates require floor support. No extra positions generated.
protocol.limits: The v4 output audit exposed shoe failures and motivated this review stage. This is development on a reused recording, not an independent final benchmark.
